usageNotes: Returns the directory index of available OpenID Connect sub-resources under /access/openid. Use this as a discovery call to enumerate what OpenID endpoints PDM exposes before calling specific OpenID operations (e.g. login, callback). No parameters are required and no special privilege is needed — all authenticated users can call it.
tips: Returns null per the spec — the actual directory listing is embedded in the API envelope (data field), not a typed schema.
Useful as a connectivity/auth smoke-test since it requires no privilege beyond a valid token.
